points.description: States that a rating curve is valid only when there is no overflow/flooding (water stays within the channel banks, no over-bank flow) in the region/river reach.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the idea is vague or partly right, e.g. mentions only stable/normal flow conditions or flood without saying it must be absent.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the rating curve holds only when there is no overflow or flood (no over-bank flow); synonyms like "flow within banks" are fine. Give 1 mark for a vague or half-correct idea, such as "normal/steady conditions" without naming absence of flood or overflow. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers, or answers saying it is valid during floods.
